states.name: normal
states.content: A fixture-only playable Room Beacon or Private Relay round presents one game prompt, one role-appropriate answer path, and a persistent game-context beacon; authentic public-figure records are excluded.
states.recovery: Commit exactly one answer, reveal the explicit fixture truth state, then continue or start a protected handoff.

states.name: loading
states.content: A future reviewed deck update must state that content is being checked while retaining the last known safe local deck; no unverifiable record becomes playable during refresh.
states.recovery: Continue with the retained safe deck or show the empty state if no safe local card exists.

states.name: empty
states.content: No safe playable cards are available because the deck is fixture-disabled, all records are withheld, removed, disputed, source-unavailable, or filtered by editorial policy.
states.recovery: Return home and wait for a reviewed deck; never substitute a withheld or candidate public-figure record.

states.name: error
states.content: A corrupt deck, failed local report write, interrupted protected transition, or unavailable offline report delivery is described in plain language without exposing protected content.
states.recovery: Use the safe home, content-unavailable, queue-locally, or fresh protected-turn path; never silently retry a committed answer.

states.name: success
states.content: After one answer, the review labels the card as fabricated-for-game or simulated-authentic fixture and explains that fixtures are not source-verified production claims; a locally queued report confirms only local storage.
states.recovery: Continue to the next Room Beacon prompt or reach the Private Relay shutter before the next player sees content.

states.name: permission-unavailable
states.content: Motion, audio, haptics, screen-reader focus, network delivery, or a source record may be unavailable. The MVP never requires motion, audio, haptics, an account, or network access to complete a fixture round.
states.recovery: Use tap-only untimed play, text-plus-shape states, local report queueing, or content-unavailable; preserve the same score and review semantics.
